text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 22, 2019 Posted by admin on January 22nd, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -162 points.
Friday the Dow was up +336.25 (+1.38%) at 24,706.35.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.91%.
All 30 Dow stocks were up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Home Depot (HD) +2.69%, UnitedHealth (UNH) +2.21%, Caterpillar (CAT) +2.18%, 3M (MMM) +2.16%, Chevron (CVX) +2.15% and Cisco (CSCO) +1.85%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were not to be found.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up seven-tenths of a cent at $2.252 per gallon.
